player_prompt.intro:
È nyɛ Jokitori {player_id} to Chopsticks. Nɛ ɛ nyɛ nɛ to, na yi kɛnɛ de:
  + Attack:  '[attack M O]'  nɛ M-nyɛ xɛxɔme mi (0 kɛ 1), O-nyɛ xɛxɔme jokitori (0 kɛ 1).
    - Jokitori xɛxɔme gbɔn na ɛ zɛɛ mi xɛxɔme; nɛ ɛ gblɛ 5, ɛ bɔna 0.
  + Split:   '[split L R]'  nɛ yi xɛxɔme mi gbɔn sɛ L kɛ R (L+R = xɛxɔme mi gbɔn).
Na yi kɛnɛ de kɛ ɛ.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Akpá ɔ́ ɖó na ɖyɔ alɔ towe lɛ sín kancica.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Nukun nu wɔn. Na yi „[attack M O]” kɛ „[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} attacks P{opp_id}’s hand {opp_idx}: it goes from {opp_val} to {new_val}.

outcome.win: Alɔ e ɖò ye sí lɛ é we bǐ kú.
outcome.draw: È ko kpé fí e è ɖó na lɛ́ kɔ dó é.
